entities.summary: Michael Joseph Curley was an Irish-born American Catholic prelate who served as the first archbishop of Washington in the District of Columbia from 1939 to 1947. He previously served as Archbishop of Baltimore in Maryland (1921–1947) and as bishop of St. Augustine in Florida (1914–1921).
